title: Material, Texture, Bake & VFX Production Pipeline
objective: Provide deterministic material, texture, bake and VFX production preparation over completed PCA recipe/graph foundations: procedural material recipes, image-to-material preprocessing, tiling/map generation, texture baking, atlas/flipbook preparation, LOD-oriented derivatives, artifact detection and visual/technical QC while preserving ARI resource/provenance/rights authority and keeping optional DCC/VFX adapters replaceable.

scope.purpose: Provide provider/DCC-independent deterministic material/texture/bake/VFX production preparation over PCA-01/PCA-02/PCA-03 outputs without creating a general sculpting, cloth or fluid package and without bypassing ARI identity/provenance/rights authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative PCA/ARI-governed source resources can deterministically prepare inspectable material/texture/bake/VFX derivative plans, QC findings and cache/provenance evidence with fail-closed invalid references/rights/adapter states, while preserving ARI owner authority and remaining useful with optional commercial DCC/VFX tools disabled.

selection_boundaries: PCA-01, PCA-02 and PCA-03 remain completed foundations and were composed rather than reimplemented or weakened.

ARI-02/ARI-03/ARI-11 remain resource identity, derivative-lineage and rights/use authority; PCA-04 produced candidate derivative/registration plans only and performed no ARI registration or rights/lineage mutation.
Material, texture, bake and VFX outputs remain candidate derivatives; visual/technical QC findings remain diagnostics and do not become canonical owner truth or release approval.

Optional DCC/provider adapters remain replaceable; PCA-04 performed no credential access, network/provider execution, paid-service operation, procurement, public upload, release or canonical mutation.

Minimum GREEN was established at a9d21201dea6468a0bded2438136934f07e30976 and production remained frozen thereafter; only governance, compliance and source-governance verifier proof files were added before terminal validation.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after exact-tree publication. PCA-04 unlocks no rotation gate; MCS still requires PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER, so PCA-05 is the lawful next selected item.
PCA-05 is selected_not_started only; no branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. PCA-06+, MSAS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
next_action: PCA-04 is closed. PCA-05 is selected_not_started after fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
